NASB.1: Behold, the LORD lays the earth waste, devastates it, distorts its surface and scatters its inhabitants.
NASB.2: And the people will be like the priest, the servant like his master, the maid like her mistress, the buyer like the seller, the lender like the borrower, the creditor like the debtor.
NASB.3: The earth will be completely laid waste and completely despoiled, for the LORD has spoken this word.
NASB.4: The earth mourns [and] withers, the world fades [and] withers, the exalted of the people of the earth fade away.
NASB.5: The earth is also polluted by its inhabitants, for they transgressed laws, violated statutes, broke the everlasting covenant.
NASB.6: Therefore, a curse devours the earth, and those who live in it are held guilty. Therefore, the inhabitants of the earth are burned, and few men are left.
NASB.7: The new wine mourns, The vine decays, All the merry-hearted sigh.
NASB.8: The gaiety of tambourines ceases, The noise of revelers stops, The gaiety of the harp ceases.
NASB.9: They do not drink wine with song; Strong drink is bitter to those who drink it.
NASB.10: The city of chaos is broken down; Every house is shut up so that none may enter.
NASB.11: There is an outcry in the streets concerning the wine; All joy turns to gloom. The gaiety of the earth is banished.
NASB.12: Desolation is left in the city And the gate is battered to ruins.
NASB.13: For thus it will be in the midst of the earth among the peoples, As the shaking of an olive tree, As the gleanings when the grape harvest is over.
NASB.14: They raise their voices, they shout for joy; They cry out from the west concerning the majesty of the LORD.
NASB.15: Therefore glorify the LORD in the east, The name of the LORD, the God of Israel, In the coastlands of the sea.
NASB.16: From the ends of the earth we hear songs, 'Glory to the Righteous One,' But I say, 'Woe to me! Woe to me! Alas for me! The treacherous deal treacherously, And the treacherous deal very treacherously.'
NASB.17: Terror and pit and snare Confront you, O inhabitant of the earth.
NASB.18: Then it will be that he who flees the report of disaster will fall into the pit, And he who climbs out of the pit will be caught in the snare; For the windows above are opened, and the foundations of the earth shake.
NASB.19: The earth is broken asunder, The earth is split through, The earth is shaken violently.
NASB.20: The earth reels to and fro like a drunkard And it totters like a shack, For its transgression is heavy upon it, And it will fall, never to rise again.
NASB.21: So it will happen in that day, That the LORD will punish the host of heaven on high, And the kings of the earth on earth.
NASB.22: They will be gathered together [Like] prisoners in the dungeon, And will be confined in prison; And after many days they [will] [be] punished.
NASB.23: Then the moon will be abashed and the sun ashamed, For the LORD of hosts will reign on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem, And [His] glory will be before His elders.

NKJV.1: Behold, the LORD makes the earth empty and makes it waste, Distorts its surface And scatters abroad its inhabitants.
NKJV.2: And it shall be: As with the people, so with the priest; As with the servant, so with his master; As with the maid, so with her mistress;  As with the buyer, so with the seller; As with the lender, so with the borrower; As with the creditor, so with the debtor.
NKJV.3: The land shall be entirely emptied and utterly plundered, For the LORD has spoken this word.
NKJV.4: The earth mourns and fades away, The world languishes and fades away; The haughty people of the earth languish.
NKJV.5: The earth is also defiled under its inhabitants, Because they have transgressed the laws, Changed the ordinance, Broken the everlasting covenant.
NKJV.6: Therefore the curse has devoured the earth, And those who dwell in it are desolate. Therefore the inhabitants of the earth are burned, And few men are left.
NKJV.7: The new wine fails, the vine languishes, All the merry-hearted sigh.
NKJV.8: The mirth of the tambourine ceases, The noise of the jubilant ends, The joy of the harp ceases.
NKJV.9: They shall not drink wine with a song; Strong drink is bitter to those who drink it.
NKJV.10: The city of confusion is broken down; Every house is shut up, so that none may go in.
NKJV.11: There is a cry for wine in the streets, All joy is darkened, The mirth of the land is gone.
NKJV.12: In the city desolation is left, And the gate is stricken with destruction.
NKJV.13: When it shall be thus in the midst of the land among the people, It shall be like the shaking of an olive tree, Like the gleaning of grapes when the vintage is done.
NKJV.14: They shall lift up their voice, they shall sing; For the majesty of the LORD They shall cry aloud from the sea.
NKJV.15: Therefore glorify the LORD in the dawning light,  The name of the LORD God of Israel in the coastlands of the sea.
NKJV.16: From the ends of the earth we have heard songs: “Glory to the righteous!” But I said, “I am ruined, ruined! Woe to me!  The treacherous dealers have dealt treacherously, Indeed, the treacherous dealers have dealt very treacherously.”
NKJV.17: Fear and the pit and the snare Are upon you, O inhabitant of the earth.
NKJV.18: And it shall be That he who flees from the noise of the fear Shall fall into the pit, And he who comes up from the midst of the pit Shall be caught in the snare; For the windows from on high are open, And the foundations of the earth are shaken.
NKJV.19: The earth is violently broken, The earth is split open, The earth is shaken exceedingly.
NKJV.20: The earth shall reel to and fro like a drunkard, And shall totter like a hut; Its transgression shall be heavy upon it, And it will fall, and not rise again.
NKJV.21: It shall come to pass in that day That the LORD will punish on high the host of exalted ones, And on the earth the kings of the earth.
NKJV.22: They will be gathered together, As prisoners are gathered in the pit, And will be shut up in the prison; After many days they will be punished.
NKJV.23: Then the moon will be disgraced And the sun ashamed; For the LORD of hosts will reign On Mount Zion and in Jerusalem And before His elders, gloriously.

ESV.1: Behold, the LORD will empty the earth  and make it desolate, and he will twist its surface and scatter its inhabitants.
ESV.2: And it shall be, as with the people, so with the priest; as with the slave, so with his master; as with the maid, so with her mistress; as with the buyer, so with the seller; as with the lender, so with the borrower; as with the creditor, so with the debtor.
ESV.3: The earth shall be utterly empty and utterly plundered; for the LORD has spoken this word.
ESV.4: The earth mourns and withers; the world languishes and withers; the highest people of the earth languish.
ESV.5: The earth lies defiled under its inhabitants; for they have transgressed the laws, violated the statutes, broken the everlasting covenant.
ESV.6: Therefore a curse devours the earth, and its inhabitants suffer for their guilt; therefore the inhabitants of the earth are scorched, and few men are left.
ESV.7: The wine mourns, the vine languishes, all the merry-hearted sigh.
ESV.8: The mirth of the tambourines is stilled, the noise of the jubilant has ceased, the mirth of the lyre is stilled.
ESV.9: No more do they drink wine with singing; strong drink is bitter to those who drink it.
ESV.10: The wasted city is broken down; every house is shut up so that none can enter.
ESV.11: There is an outcry in the streets for lack of wine; all joy has grown dark; the gladness of the earth is banished.
ESV.12: Desolation is left in the city; the gates are battered into ruins.
ESV.13: For thus it shall be in the midst of the earth among the nations, as when an olive tree is beaten, as at the gleaning when the grape harvest is done.
ESV.14: They lift up their voices, they sing for joy; over the majesty of the LORD they shout from the west.
ESV.15: Therefore in the east  give glory to the LORD; in the coastlands of the sea, give glory to the name of the LORD, the God of Israel.
ESV.16: From the ends of the earth we hear songs of praise, of glory to the Righteous One. But I say, “I waste away, I waste away. Woe is me! For the traitors have betrayed, with betrayal the traitors have betrayed.”
ESV.17: Terror and the pit and the snare  are upon you, O inhabitant of the earth!
ESV.18: He who flees at the sound of the terror shall fall into the pit, and he who climbs out of the pit shall be caught in the snare. For the windows of heaven are opened, and the foundations of the earth tremble.
ESV.19: The earth is utterly broken, the earth is split apart, the earth is violently shaken.
ESV.20: The earth staggers like a drunken man; it sways like a hut; its transgression lies heavy upon it, and it falls, and will not rise again.
ESV.21: On that day the LORD will punish the host of heaven, in heaven, and the kings of the earth, on the earth.
ESV.22: They will be gathered together as prisoners in a pit; they will be shut up in a prison, and after many days they will be punished.
ESV.23: Then the moon will be confounded and the sun ashamed, for the LORD of hosts reigns on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem, and his glory will be before his elders.

NLT.1:
Look! The LORD is about to destroy the earth
and make it a vast wasteland.
He devastates the surface of the earth
and scatters the people.
NLT.2:
Priests and laypeople,
servants and masters,
maids and mistresses,
buyers and sellers,
lenders and borrowers,
bankers and debtors — none will be spared.
NLT.3:
The earth will be completely emptied and looted.
The LORD has spoken!
NLT.4:
The earth mourns and dries up,
and the land wastes away and withers.
Even the greatest people on earth waste away.
NLT.5:
The earth suffers for the sins of its people,
for they have twisted God’s instructions,
violated his laws,
and broken his everlasting covenant.
NLT.6:
Therefore, a curse consumes the earth.
Its people must pay the price for their sin.
They are destroyed by fire,
and only a few are left alive.
NLT.7:
The grapevines waste away,
and there is no new wine.
All the merrymakers sigh and mourn.
NLT.8:
The cheerful sound of tambourines is stilled;
the happy cries of celebration are heard no more.
The melodious chords of the harp are silent.
NLT.9:
Gone are the joys of wine and song;
alcoholic drink turns bitter in the mouth.
NLT.10:
The city writhes in chaos;
every home is locked to keep out intruders.
NLT.11:
Mobs gather in the streets, crying out for wine.
Joy has turned to gloom.
Gladness has been banished from the land.
NLT.12:
The city is left in ruins,
its gates battered down.
NLT.13:
Throughout the earth the story is the same —
only a remnant is left,
like the stray olives left on the tree
or the few grapes left on the vine after harvest.
NLT.14:
But all who are left shout and sing for joy.
Those in the west praise the LORD’s majesty.
NLT.15:
In eastern lands, give glory to the LORD.
In the lands beyond the sea, praise the name of the LORD, the God of Israel.
NLT.16:
We hear songs of praise from the ends of the earth,
songs that give glory to the Righteous One!
But my heart is heavy with grief.
Weep for me, for I wither away.
Deceit still prevails,
and treachery is everywhere.
NLT.17:
Terror and traps and snares will be your lot,
you people of the earth.
NLT.18:
Those who flee in terror will fall into a trap,
and those who escape the trap will be caught in a snare.
Destruction falls like rain from the heavens;
the foundations of the earth shake.
NLT.19:
The earth has broken up.
It has utterly collapsed;
it is violently shaken.
NLT.20:
The earth staggers like a drunk.
It trembles like a tent in a storm.
It falls and will not rise again,
for the guilt of its rebellion is very heavy.
NLT.21:
In that day the LORD will punish the gods in the heavens
and the proud rulers of the nations on earth.
NLT.22:
They will be rounded up and put in prison.
They will be shut up in prison
and will finally be punished.
NLT.23:
Then the glory of the moon will wane,
and the brightness of the sun will fade,
for the LORD of Heaven’s Armies will rule on Mount Zion.
He will rule in great glory in Jerusalem,
in the sight of all the leaders of his people.

WEB.1: Behold, Yahweh makes the earth empty, makes it waste, turns it upside down, and scatters its inhabitants.
WEB.2: It will be as with the people, so with the priest; as with the servant, so with his master; as with the maid, so with her mistress; as with the buyer, so with the seller; as with the creditor, so with the debtor; as with the taker of interest, so with the giver of interest.
WEB.3: The earth will be utterly emptied and utterly laid waste; for Yahweh has spoken this word.
WEB.4: The earth mourns and fades away. The world languishes and fades away. The lofty people of the earth languish.
WEB.5: The earth also is polluted under its inhabitants, because they have transgressed the laws, violated the statutes, and broken the everlasting covenant.
WEB.6: Therefore the curse has devoured the earth, and those who dwell therein are found guilty. Therefore the inhabitants of the earth are burned, and few men left.
WEB.7: The new wine mourns. The vine languishes. All the merry-hearted sigh.
WEB.8: The mirth of tambourines ceases. The sound of those who rejoice ends. The joy of the harp ceases.
WEB.9: They will not drink wine with a song. Strong drink will be bitter to those who drink it.
WEB.10: The confused city is broken down. Every house is shut up, that no man may come in.
WEB.11: There is a crying in the streets because of the wine. All joy is darkened. The mirth of the land is gone.
WEB.12: The city is left in desolation, and the gate is struck with destruction.
WEB.13: For it will be so within the earth among the peoples, as the shaking of an olive tree, as the gleanings when the vintage is done.
WEB.14: These shall lift up their voice. They will shout for the majesty of Yahweh. They cry aloud from the sea.
WEB.15: Therefore glorify Yahweh in the east, even the name of Yahweh, the God of Israel, in the islands of the sea!
WEB.16: From the uttermost part of the earth have we heard songs. Glory to the righteous! But I said, “I pine away! I pine away! woe is me!” The treacherous have dealt treacherously. Yes, the treacherous have dealt very treacherously.
WEB.17: Fear, the pit, and the snare, are on you who inhabitant the earth.
WEB.18: It will happen that he who flees from the noise of the fear will fall into the pit; and he who comes up out of the middle of the pit will be taken in the snare; for the windows on high are opened, and the foundations of the earth tremble.
WEB.19: The earth is utterly broken. The earth is torn apart. The earth is shaken violently.
WEB.20: The earth will stagger like a drunken man, and will sway back and forth like a hammock. Its disobedience will be heavy on it, and it will fall and not rise again.
WEB.21: It shall happen in that day that Yahweh will punish the army of the high ones on high, and the kings of the earth on the earth.
WEB.22: They shall be gathered together, as prisoners are gathered in the pit, and shall be shut up in the prison; and after many days shall they be visited.
WEB.23: Then the moon shall be confounded, and the sun ashamed; for Yahweh of Armies will reign on Mount Zion, and in Jerusalem; and before his elders will be glory.

AMP.1: Behold, the LORD lays waste to the earth, devastates it, twists and distorts its face and scatters its inhabitants.
AMP.2: And the people will be like the priest, the servant like his master, the maid like her mistress, the buyer like the seller, the lender like the borrower, the creditor like the debtor [as God's impartial judgment of sin comes on all].
AMP.3: The earth will be completely laid waste and utterly pillaged, for the LORD has spoken this word.
AMP.4: The earth dries up and crumbles away, the world dries out and crumbles away, the exalted of the people of the earth fade away.
AMP.5: The earth also is polluted by its inhabitants, because they have transgressed laws, violated statutes, and broken the everlasting covenant.
AMP.6: Therefore, a curse devours the earth, and those who live on it suffer the punishment of their guilt. Therefore, the inhabitants of the earth are burned [under the curse of God's wrath], and few people are left.
AMP.7:
The new wine mourns,
The vine decays;
All the merry-hearted sigh and groan.
AMP.8:
The mirth of the timbrels (tambourines) ceases,
The noise of those who rejoice ends,
The joy of the harp ceases.
AMP.9:
They do not drink wine with a song;
Strong drink is bitter to those who drink it.
AMP.10:
The city of chaos is broken down;
Every house is shut up so that no one may enter.
AMP.11:
There is an outcry in the streets concerning the wine;
All jubilation is darkened,
The joy of the earth is banished.
AMP.12:
Horrible desolation is left in the city,
And the gate is battered into ruins.
AMP.13:
For so it will be in the midst of the earth among the peoples,
As the shaking of an olive tree,
As the gleanings when the grape harvest is over [and only a little of the fruit remains].
AMP.14:
They [who have escaped and remain] raise their voices, they shout for joy;
They rejoice from the [Mediterranean] Sea in the majesty of the LORD.
AMP.15:
Therefore honor and glorify the LORD in the east [in the region of light],
The name of the LORD, the God of Israel [honor His name],
In the coastlands and islands of the [Mediterranean] Sea.
AMP.16:
From the ends of the earth we hear songs, "Glory and honor to the Righteous One,"
But I say, "I waste away, I waste away. Woe to me!
The treacherous deal treacherously,
Indeed, the treacherous deal very treacherously."
AMP.17:
Terror and pit [of destruction] and snare
Confront you, O inhabitant of the earth.
AMP.18:
Then it will be that he who flees at the sound of terror will fall into the pit,
And he who comes up out of the pit will be caught in the snare;
For the windows of heaven are opened, and the foundations of the earth tremble.
AMP.19:
The earth is broken completely apart,
The earth is split apart,
The earth is shaken violently.
AMP.20:
The earth reels back and forth like a drunkard
And sways like a shack;
Its transgression lies heavily upon it,
And it will fall and not rise again.
AMP.21:
So it will happen in that day
That the LORD will visit and punish the host (fallen angels) of heaven on high,
And the kings of the earth on the earth.
AMP.22:
They will be gathered together
As prisoners [are gathered] in a dungeon;
They will be shut up in prison,
And after many days they will be visited and punished.
AMP.23:
Then the full moon will be embarrassed and the sun ashamed,
For the LORD of hosts will reign on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem,
And His glory and brilliance will shine before His elders.

CSB17.1:

MSG.1:
Danger ahead! God's about to ravish the earth
and leave it in ruins,
Rip everything out by the roots
and send everyone scurrying:
MSG.2:
priests and laypeople alike,
owners and workers alike,
celebrities and nobodies alike,
buyers and sellers alike,
bankers and beggars alike,
the haves and have-nots alike.
MSG.3:
The landscape will be a moonscape,
totally wasted.
And why? Because God says so.
He's issued the orders.
MSG.4:
The earth turns gaunt and gray,
the world silent and sad,
sky and land lifeless, colorless.
MSG.5:
Earth is polluted by its very own people,
who have broken its laws,
Disrupted its order,
violated the sacred and eternal covenant.
MSG.6:
Therefore a curse, like a cancer,
ravages the earth.
Its people pay the price of their sacrilege.
They dwindle away, dying out one by one.
MSG.7:
No more wine, no more vineyards,
no more songs or singers.
MSG.8:
The laughter of castanets is gone,
the shouts of celebrants, gone,
the laughter of fiddles, gone.
MSG.9:
No more parties with toasts of champagne.
Serious drinkers gag on their drinks.
MSG.10:
The chaotic cities are unlivable. Anarchy reigns.
Every house is boarded up, condemned.
MSG.11:
People riot in the streets for wine,
but the good times are gone forever—
no more joy for this old world.
MSG.12:
The city is dead and deserted,
bulldozed into piles of rubble.
MSG.13:
That's the way it will be on this earth.
This is the fate of all nations:
An olive tree shaken clean of its olives,
a grapevine picked clean of its grapes.
MSG.14:
But there are some who will break into glad song.
Out of the west they'll shout of God's majesty.
MSG.15:
Yes, from the east God's glory will ascend.
Every island of the sea
Will broadcast God's fame,
the fame of the God of Israel.
MSG.16:
From the four winds and the seven seas we hear the singing:
"All praise to the Righteous One!"
But I said, "That's all well and good for somebody,
but all I can see is doom, doom, and more doom."
All of them at one another's throats,
yes, all of them at one another's throats.
MSG.17:
Terror and pits and booby traps
are everywhere, whoever you are.
MSG.18:
If you run from the terror,
you'll fall into the pit.
If you climb out of the pit,
you'll get caught in the trap.
Chaos pours out of the skies.
The foundations of earth are crumbling.
MSG.19:
Earth is smashed to pieces,
earth is ripped to shreds,
earth is wobbling out of control,
MSG.20:
Earth staggers like a drunk,
sways like a shack in a high wind.
Its piled-up sins are too much for it.
It collapses and won't get up again.
MSG.21:
That's when God will call on the carpet
rebel powers in the skies and
Rebel kings on earth.
MSG.22:
They'll be rounded up like prisoners in a jail,
Corralled and locked up in a jail,
and then sentenced and put to hard labor.
MSG.23:
Shamefaced moon will cower, humiliated,
red-faced sun will skulk, disgraced,
Because God-of-the-Angel-Armies will take over,
ruling from Mount Zion and Jerusalem,
Splendid and glorious
before all his leaders.

NIV.1:
The Lord’s Devastation of the Earth
See, the Lord is going to lay waste the earth
and devastate it;
he will ruin its face
and scatter its inhabitants—
NIV.2:
it will be the same
for priest as for people,
for master as for servant,
for mistress as for maid,
for seller as for buyer,
for borrower as for lender,
for debtor as for creditor.
NIV.3:
The earth will be completely laid waste
and totally plundered.
The Lord has spoken this word.
NIV.4:
The earth dries up and withers,
the world languishes and withers,
the exalted of the earth languish.
NIV.5:
The earth is defiled by its people;
they have disobeyed the laws,
violated the statutes
and broken the everlasting covenant.
NIV.6:
Therefore a curse consumes the earth;
its people must bear their guilt.
Therefore earth’s inhabitants are burned up,
and very few are left.
NIV.7:
The new wine dries up and the vine withers;
all the merrymakers groan.
NIV.8:
The gaiety of the tambourines is stilled,
the noise of the revelers has stopped,
the joyful harp is silent.
NIV.9:
No longer do they drink wine with a song;
the beer is bitter to its drinkers.
NIV.10:
The ruined city lies desolate;
the entrance to every house is barred.
NIV.11:
In the streets they cry out for wine;
all joy turns to gloom,
all gaiety is banished from the earth.
NIV.12:
The city is left in ruins,
its gate is battered to pieces.
NIV.13:
So will it be on the earth
and among the nations,
as when an olive tree is beaten,
or as when gleanings are left after the grape harvest.
NIV.14:
They raise their voices, they shout for joy;
from the west they acclaim the Lord’s majesty.
NIV.15:
Therefore in the east give glory to the Lord;
exalt the name of the Lord, the God of Israel,
in the islands of the sea.
NIV.16:
From the ends of the earth we hear singing:
“Glory to the Righteous One.”
But I said, “I waste away, I waste away!
Woe to me!
The treacherous betray!
With treachery the treacherous betray!”
NIV.17:
Terror and pit and snare await you,
O people of the earth.
NIV.18:
Whoever flees at the sound of terror
will fall into a pit;
whoever climbs out of the pit
will be caught in a snare.
The floodgates of the heavens are opened,
the foundations of the earth shake.
NIV.19:
The earth is broken up,
the earth is split asunder,
the earth is thoroughly shaken.
NIV.20:
The earth reels like a drunkard,
it sways like a hut in the wind;
so heavy upon it is the guilt of its rebellion
that it falls—never to rise again.
NIV.21:
In that day the Lord will punish
the powers in the heavens above
and the kings on the earth below.
NIV.22:
They will be herded together
like prisoners bound in a dungeon;
they will be shut up in prison
and be punished after many days.
NIV.23:
The moon will be abashed, the sun ashamed;
for the Lord Almighty will reign
on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem,
and before its elders, gloriously.

NET.1: Look, the LORD is ready to devastate the earth and leave it in ruins; he will mar its surface and scatter its inhabitants.
NET.2: Everyone will suffer — the priest as well as the people, the master as well as the servant, the elegant lady as well as the female attendant, the seller as well as the buyer, the borrower as well as the lender, the creditor as well as the debtor.
NET.3: The earth will be completely devastated and thoroughly ransacked. For the LORD has decreed this judgment.
NET.4: The earth dries up and withers, the world shrivels up and withers; the prominent people of the earth fade away.
NET.5: The earth is defiled by its inhabitants, for they have violated laws, disregarded the regulation, and broken the permanent treaty.
NET.6: So a treaty curse devours the earth; its inhabitants pay for their guilt. This is why the inhabitants of the earth disappear, and are reduced to just a handful of people.
NET.7: The new wine dries up, the vines shrivel up, all those who like to celebrate groan.
NET.8: The happy sound of the tambourines stops, the revelry of those who celebrate comes to a halt, the happy sound of the harp ceases.
NET.9: They no longer sing and drink wine; the beer tastes bitter to those who drink it.
NET.10: The ruined town is shattered; all of the houses are shut up tight.
NET.11: They howl in the streets because of what happened to the wine; all joy turns to sorrow; celebrations disappear from the earth.
NET.12: The city is left in ruins; the gate is reduced to rubble.
NET.13: This is what will happen throughout the earth, among the nations. It will be like when they beat an olive tree, and just a few olives are left at the end of the harvest.
NET.14: They lift their voices and shout joyfully; they praise the majesty of the LORD in the west.
NET.15: So in the east extol the LORD, along the seacoasts extol the fame of the LORD God of Israel.
NET.16: From the ends of the earth we hear songs — the Just One is majestic. But I say, “I’m wasting away! I’m wasting away! I’m doomed! Deceivers deceive, deceivers thoroughly deceive!”
NET.17: Terror, pit, and snare are ready to overtake you inhabitants of the earth!
NET.18: The one who runs away from the sound of the terror will fall into the pit; the one who climbs out of the pit, will be trapped by the snare. For the floodgates of the heavens are opened up and the foundations of the earth shake.
NET.19: The earth is broken in pieces, the earth is ripped to shreds, the earth shakes violently.
NET.20: The earth will stagger around like a drunk; it will sway back and forth like a hut in a windstorm. Its sin will weigh it down, and it will fall and never get up again.
NET.21: At that time the LORD will punish the heavenly forces in the heavens and the earthly kings on the earth.
NET.22: They will be imprisoned in a pit, locked up in a prison, and after staying there for a long time, they will be punished.
NET.23: The full moon will be covered up, the bright sun will be darkened; for the LORD who commands armies will rule on Mount Zion in Jerusalem in the presence of his assembly, in majestic splendor.
